rows.en: (Today I'm seeing a movie with Claire-senpai!)

Hello!
We're both right on time!
I'm glad I wasn't late.
Well then, shall we head to the theater?

That was a good movie~
The last scene made me all teary-eyed.
Teary-eyed? Weren't you actually crying?
rows.notes: Male, and female in the repeat visit.

rows.en:
O-of course I wasn't...
You saw wrong! You totally saw wrong!

W-well then, let's go get something to eat!
Follow me!
(Today was a nice change of pace.)
rows.notes: x147, end line of Outing scenes; also used in female scenes, so kept gender-neutral.

rows.en: (Today I'm seeing a movie with Claire-senpai again!)

Hello!
I'm glad we made it on time.
rows.notes: Claire; 'not late' read as both of them, the player answers 'right on time'.

rows.en: Yeah, we were right on time.

What a lovely movie...
The last scene made me all teary-eyed.

(Today I'm going shopping with Claire-senpai!
We're meeting up in Deep Akihabara, but...)

\p-kun, you're late!
Keeping a woman waiting? That's no good.
I-I'm sorry!!
Hehehe, be more careful from now on, okay?
Well then, let's go shopping.
It's really hard to find, isn't it...
rows.notes: They are hunting for a bath TV.

rows.en: Do they even make TVs for the bath?

It's been my dream for so long...
Watching TV in the bath...

I wonder if there's one out there
if we keep looking.

We keep looking until we find one!
I need to do some research before next time...!
(Claire-senpai is really fired up...)

(Today I invited Claire-senpai to the pool!)

Hello, \p-kun.
It's been ages since I came to the Academy pool.
Well then, shall we go get changed?

Do your warm-ups properly, okay?
Accidents in the water are no joke.
Okay. You be careful too, Claire-senpai.

I'll be fine.
I'm not going to swim...

Wh-what's with that look...
I can't swim, so what else can I do...
Then I'll teach you!
Really?
Well then, maybe I'll take you up on that.

(I spent the whole day swimming with
Claire-senpai. What fun!)

The pool again, huh?

Since we're here anyway,
let's get you swimming for real!
Let's do our warm-ups properly.

Sure.
Then, will you push on my back for me?
Why are you getting shy about it now...
You're making me embarrassed too...
Th-then, here I go. I'm pushing.
Mm, please do.
